description: Provision a Google Cloud Bigtable BigtableAppProfile via Config Connector. Fields mirror the bigtable.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 BigtableAppProfile spec.

dataBoostIsolationReadOnly.description: Specifies that this app profile is intended for read-only usage via the Data Boost feature. Please opt-in to this feature by setting the `alpha.cnrm.cloud.google.com/reconciler: direct` annotation.

computeBillingOwner.description: The Compute Billing Owner for this Data Boost App Profile.

description.description: Long form description of the use case for this AppProfile.

instanceRef.description: InstanceRef is a reference to a BigtableInstance. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed BigtableInstance resource.

name.description: The name of a BigtableInstance resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a BigtableInstance resource.

multiClusterRoutingClusterIds.description: The set of clusters to route to, if using multi cluster routing. The order is ignored; clusters will be tried in order of distance. If left empty, all clusters are eligible.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

resourceID.description: The BigtableAppProfile name. If not given, the metadata.name will be used.

allowTransactionalWrites.description: Whether or not `CheckAndMutateRow` and `ReadModifyWriteRow` requests are allowed by this app profile. It is unsafe to send these requests to the same table/row/column in multiple clusters.

clusterId.description: The cluster to which read/write requests should be routed.

standardIsolation.description: The standard options used for isolating this app profile's traffic from other use cases.

priority.description: The priority of requests sent using this app profile.

title: GCP Bigtable BigtableAppProfile
